name: FURRY MASSAGE 🔞
source: Got magic hands? Prove it! Become the new masseur for a town full of beautiful furry girls. From sore wings to tense tails, they all crave your touch. Pick your client, choose the perfect pose, and hit the right spots to bring them to ultimate ecstasy.
